pages.en: Lily and Mia go to the city centre with Mia's dad. There is a big market in the square. Mia stops to look at some earrings.
pages.zh: Lily 和 Mia 跟着 Mia 的爸爸去市中心。广场上有个大集市。Mia 停下来看一些耳环。
pages.scene: A busy town square with market stalls, Lily and Mia walking with Mia's dad, Mia stopping to look at a stall with earrings.

pages.en: When Lily turns round, Mia isn't there! Lily is worried. She looks round the corner and down the street, but she can't see Mia.
pages.zh: Lily 一转身，Mia 不见了！Lily 很着急。她看了看拐角，又看了看街道那头，可还是看不到 Mia。
pages.scene: Lily standing on a street corner looking worried, Mia's dad looking down a busy street full of people and shops.

pages.en: Then she hears, "Lily! I'm here!" Mia is in the middle of the square with a police officer. "Stay together!" says Mia's dad, and they all laugh.
pages.zh: 这时她听到：“Lily！我在这儿！”Mia 站在广场中间，身边有一位警察。“大家要待在一起！”Mia 的爸爸说，大家都笑了。
pages.scene: A fountain in a town square, Mia waving next to a friendly police officer, Lily running to her, Mia's dad looking happy.

questions.q: They go to the city centre.
Where is Mia at the end?
options: in the middle of the square

questions.zh: Mia 和一位老师在一起。
